verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an IP office offering online filing and search services, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents web portals (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, DPMAdirektWeb) and the downloadable DPMAdirektPro application software. None of these is described as a command-line interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
